paper.citation: Choi, B. Y., Fine, J. P., and Brookhart, M. A. (2017). On two-stage estimation of structural instrumental variable models. Biometrika 104(4), 881-899. DOI 10.1093/biomet/asx056.
paper.source_locator: PMC author manuscript Section 4 Case 1B, equations (12)-(13) (Equation35.gif/Equation36.gif) and simulation parameter/censoring paragraph; Section 3.2 observed outcome min/event indicator, Section 3.3 left censoring sign reversal. Original equation GIFs visually read and saved in local source audit. No author software used; commit not applicable.

mechanism.name: IV: left-censored continuous exposure and right-censored outcome

generation_equations.label: Covariates and errors
generation_equations.expression: V1,V2,W1,W2,U iid N(0,1) conditional on [-2,2]; epsilon,delta iid N(0,1), independent of all covariates.

generation_equations.label: Latent exposure and outcome
generation_equations.expression: D=1+V1+V2+W1+W2+U+delta; Y=1+D+W1+W2+U+epsilon; all source Eq12/13 parameters1.

generation_equations.label: Independent censoring
generation_equations.expression: C_Y~Uniform(0,13.249945942133955); C_D~Uniform(-7,2.629814945797971); independent of all other variables and each other. Endpoints numerically calibrated to20% population censoring as an explicit adaptation.

generation_equations.label: Observed values
generation_equations.expression: D_observed=max(D,C_D); D_exact=I(D>=C_D); Y_observed=min(Y,C_Y); Y_event=I(Y<=C_Y). Return V1,V2,W1,W2,D_observed,D_exact,Y_observed,Y_event only.

evidence.expression: epsilon,delta iid N(0,1), independent of all covariates.

sampling.dependence: iid individuals; two independent truncated-normal instruments, two independent measured confounders and latent U. Shared U induces D,Y dependence; independent censoring thresholds.

assumptions: Independent instruments V1,V2, measured W1,W2 and latent U; instruments affect Y only through D
Nonzero instrument relevance: both exposure coefficients1
Independent normal structural innovations; unobserved U creates exposure/outcome confounding
Censoring thresholds independently generated from uniforms; proper left-exposure and right-outcome indicators retained
Uniform censoring support and AFT/rank identification require scientific review; machine checks establish generation/truth, not general missing-data identification

properties.notes: Linear latent structural law with shared unobserved confounder. Nonlinearity is the observed max(D,C_D) left censoring and min(Y,C_Y) right censoring; four observed baseline/instrument variables are bounded independent truncated normals.

estimand.name: alpha_YZ
estimand.definition: Structural coefficient1 of the true, possibly unobserved continuous exposure D in Y(d)=1+d+W1+W2+U+epsilon. Thus E[Y(d+1)-Y(d)]=1 on source linear/log-time outcome scale, not effect on exp(Y) survival time or complier LATE.

truth.expression: Structural coefficient1 of the true, possibly unobserved continuous exposure D in Y(d)=1+d+W1+W2+U+epsilon. Thus E[Y(d+1)-Y(d)]=1 on source linear/log-time outcome scale, not effect on exp(Y) survival time or complier LATE.
truth.derivation: Unit exposure intervention contrast alpha_YZ=1; independent latent IV population moment, rejection-sampler full-law comparison and censoring calibration diagnostics.

adaptations: Select source Case1B with all equation12/13 parameters1, two observed confounders and two instruments, independent standard-Normal errors, independent standard-Normal covariates truncated to [-2,2]. Explicit independent-covariate reading recorded because source prose does not list every pairwise dependence.

Source specifies Uniform(0,cy) right censoring and Uniform(-7,cz) left censoring at desired20%, without numeric endpoints. Derive cy=13.249945942133955 and cz=2.629814945797971 by deterministic midpoint-quadrature/FFT population convolution and root solving (8192 bins per four-unit covariate interval); record calibration grid convergence separately.
All censoring is applied on the source's linear/log-time scale; no exponentiation, zero truncation, complete-case deletion or uncensored-value leakage.
Independent NumPy/SciPy sampling, caller n/seed; omit rank fitting, perturbation resampling and CI coverage.
